1.d4 d5 2.Nc3 f5.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Veresov Attack, Dutch System

1.d4 d5 2.Nc3 f5 3.e4.strategy: A pawn gambit: the e-pawn is offered at once to open the centre and exploit the loosened kingside and a lead in development. Black can simply accept the pawn and develop, and White has to prove its compensation.
1.d4 d5 2.Nc3 f5 3.e4.name: Dutch Defence: Kingfisher Gambit
